visites.name: Nantes Bike Tour: the Nantes panorama
visites.alt: A guided bike tour group in front of the Great Elephant at Les Machines de l'île
visites.meet: Place de Bretagne, at the foot of the Tour de Bretagne
visites.title: Guided E-bike Tour of Nantes | Bike'N Tour
visites.meta: Explore Nantes by e-bike with a local guide: Château des ducs, Les Machines de l'île, Le Voyage à Nantes. 2.5 hrs, €44 per person, max 12 people.
visites.lead: The Château des ducs de Bretagne, the Elephant at Les Machines de l'île, the Voyage à Nantes artworks and the banks of the Loire – effortlessly by e-bike, with a guide who knows the city inside out.

stops.texte: Briefing, bike fitting and an introduction to the route.

stops.lieu: Saint-Mihiel and the banks of the Erdre
stops.texte: Quai de Versailles, the barges and the Japanese garden on Île de Versailles.

stops.lieu: Quai Ceineray and Cours des 50 Otages
stops.texte: How water shaped Nantes, from the Vikings to the filling-in of the Loire's channels.

stops.lieu: Medieval quarter and Place du Bouffay
stops.texte: The narrow streets of the old walled town.

stops.lieu: Château des ducs and Tour LU
stops.texte: Is Nantes in Brittany? The life of Anne of Brittany, then the tasty story of LU biscuits.
The former shipyards, now a creative quarter, and the giant Elephant.

stops.lieu: Graslin, Passage Pommeraye and Place Royale
stops.texte: The elegance of 19th-century Nantes, before heading back to the Tour de Bretagne.

visites.name: Wine & Bike Tour in Nantes
visites.alt: A break during a guided bike tour in the centre of Nantes
visites.meet: Place de Bretagne, at the foot of the Tour de Bretagne (tram T3, Bretagne stop)
visites.title: Wine & Bike Tour Nantes: Bike and Tasting | Bike'N Tour
visites.meta: Guided e-bike tour of Nantes with a tasting of 3 Loire wines and local cheeses on the banks of the Loire. 3.5 hrs, €65 per person.
visites.lead: The city and the Nantes vineyards in one ride: the story of Muscadet and Loire wines, then a tasting of three wines and local cheeses by the river.

stops.texte: Getting to grips with the bikes.
Quai de Versailles and Île de Versailles.
The medieval town and the history of the wine trade.
The former shipyards and Les Machines de l'île.

stops.lieu: Tasting on the banks of the Loire
stops.texte: Three wines from the Nantes vineyards and local cheeses, introduced by your guide.

included: Tasting of 3 wines and local cheeses

visites.alt: A group on bikes on Île de Nantes
visites.meet: Place de Bretagne, on the steps of the Tour de Bretagne
visites.title: “Urban Culture” Bike Tour in Nantes | Bike'N Tour
visites.meta: An “off-script” guided e-bike tour of Nantes: street art, Chantenay, Île de Nantes, the Loire banks. 2.5 hrs, €45 per person.
visites.lead: An “off-script” tour of Nantes: repurposed spaces, street art, architecture and changing neighbourhoods, from Chantenay to Île de Nantes.

stops.texte: Industrial old Nantes and its brownfield sites turned creative spaces.
The Estuaire artworks and the quaysides.
Contemporary architecture and Les Machines de l'île.
